sections.markdown:
## Day 31｜900+ 多條件排除、間接回應與 Triple Passage 跨文件推論

### 今日目標

- 用主詞核心辨認單複數一致
- 辨識分詞修飾與詞性干擾
- 整合場地容量、時段、設備與預算
- 推論間接回應與下一步
- 跨三份文件判斷報銷條件與計算

建議時間：**100 分鐘**。

sections.title: Part 5 主詞動詞一致＋分詞與詞性干擾
sections.markdown:
目標速度：**每題 12 秒**

| Pattern | Example | 說明 |
|---|---|---|
| Each of + plural noun + singular verb | Each of the invoices is checked. |  |
| A number of + plural noun + plural verb | A number of applicants are qualified. |  |
| The number of + plural noun + singular verb | The number of orders has increased. |  |
| Subject + of-phrase + verb | The list of suppliers is available. |  |
| Noun + V-ing = active reduced relative clause | Employees attending the meeting should register. |  |
| Noun + V-ed = passive reduced relative clause | Documents submitted yesterday were reviewed. |  |
| as soon as/once + present tense for future reference | We will notify you once the audit is complete. |  |

### 解題順序

- 找真正主詞
- 判斷主動/被動
- 確認詞性
- 最後檢查語意

sections.title: Listening｜L31-1 Training Venue: Competing Constraints
sections.markdown:
技能：I / P / INT / N

| venue | capacity | video | available | price |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| West Hall | 18 | included | Friday 09:00-12:00 | 260 |
| Riverside | 30 | $60 rental | Friday 09:00-12:00 | 320 |
| Harbor | 24 | included | Friday 09:00-12:00 | 450 |
| Park | 35 | included | Friday 13:00-17:00 | 390 |

聽力稿：

Man: Is West Hall still our best option for Friday's ten-to-noon orientation?
Woman: I wouldn't count on it. Twenty-two people signed up, and West Hall holds only eighteen. Riverside can seat thirty, but video equipment is an extra sixty dollars on top of the three-hundred-twenty-dollar rental.
Man: Our trainer is joining online. What about Harbor?
Woman: It has video, but the fee is four hundred fifty dollars. We have a four-hundred-dollar limit. Riverside is available that morning.
Man: Then let's go with Riverside. Can you reserve it?
Woman: Yes. I'll confirm the equipment rental and send you the booking details.

答案：

### Q1

Why is West Hall unsuitable?

(A) It is too small.  
(B) It has no video equipment.  
(C) It is closed on Friday.  
(D) It exceeds the budget.  

答案：**A**

22 participants exceed West Hall’s capacity of 18.

### Q2

Which venue will the speakers use?

(A) West Hall  
(B) Riverside  
(C) Harbor  
(D) Park  

答案：**B**

Riverside fits 22 people, is available Friday morning, supports rented video, and costs $320+$60=$380 ≤ $400.

### Q3

What does the woman imply by saying “I wouldn’t count on it”?

(A) The venue is unlikely to meet their needs.  
(B) The event has been canceled.  
(C) She has already paid the fee.  
(D) The room has more than enough seats.  

答案：**A**

Indirect response: I wouldn’t count on it = do not rely on that option.

### Q4

What will the woman most likely do next?

(A) Request a refund from Harbor.  
(B) Move the session to the afternoon.  
(C) Confirm the video rental and send booking details.  
(D) Invite fewer participants.  

答案：**C**

She explicitly promises to confirm the equipment rental and send booking details.

sections.title: Listening｜L31-2 Seminar Badges: Deadlines and Next Actions
sections.markdown:
技能：T / C / N / INT

聽力稿：

Man: We need sixty name badges for Monday's seminar. Can you handle that?
Woman: Forty-five are in stock. I can print fifteen more by Friday, provided I get the attendee list by two this afternoon.
Man: Our manager is still checking the spellings.
Woman: We can use a provisional list now; corrections are accepted until noon tomorrow. After that the printer locks the file.
Man: Time isn't on our side, is it? I'll ask the manager to send what we have before lunch.

答案：

### Q1

How many badges are already available?

(A) 15  
(B) 30  
(C) 45  
(D) 60  

答案：**C**

Forty-five are in stock; fifteen additional badges need printing.

### Q2

When must the initial attendee list be received?

(A) Before noon today  
(B) By 2 P.M. today  
(C) By noon tomorrow  
(D) By Friday  

答案：**B**

The printer needs the initial list by 2 P.M. this afternoon.

### Q3

What does “Time isn’t on our side” suggest?

(A) The schedule is tight.  
(B) The printer is broken.  
(C) The seminar has been postponed.  
(D) The badges are free.  

答案：**A**

This idiom signals urgency and little remaining time.

### Q4

What will the man do next?

(A) Cancel the seminar.  
(B) Wait for the final list tomorrow.  
(C) Ask the manager to send a provisional list before lunch.  
(D) Print the badges himself.  

答案：**C**

He says he will ask the manager to send what they have before lunch.

sections.title: Listening｜L31-3 Shipping: Deadline and Budget
sections.markdown:
技能：I / T / N

| service | arrival | fee |
|---|---|---|
| Economy | Monday | 9 |
| Standard | Friday | 18 |
| Express | Thursday | 28 |
| Priority | Wednesday | 45 |

聽力稿：

The sample kit for Friday morning's product demonstration is ready. Our staff need Thursday evening to prepare, so the package must arrive by Thursday. We can spend at most thirty dollars, and there is no reason to pay for earlier delivery. Please choose the least expensive service that meets those conditions. Once the package is dispatched, e-mail the tracking number to the sales team.

答案：

### Q1

What is being shipped?

(A) A sample kit  
(B) Office chairs  
(C) Signed contracts  
(D) Name badges  

答案：**A**

The speaker mentions a sample kit for a product demonstration.

### Q2

Which shipping service should be selected?

(A) Economy  
(B) Standard  
(C) Express  
(D) Priority  

答案：**C**

Express arrives Thursday and costs $28; Priority exceeds the $30 limit, while the other services arrive too late.

### Q3

What must happen after dispatch?

(A) The price must be renegotiated.  
(B) The sales team must receive a tracking number.  
(C) The product demonstration must be canceled.  
(D) The shipment must be returned.  

答案：**B**

The speaker requests an e-mailed tracking number after dispatch.

sections.title: Reading｜Travel Reimbursement: Policy × Itinerary × Finance Update
sections.markdown:
題型：**triple-passage**　限時：**420 秒**

### Northbridge Travel Reimbursement Policy

Economy-class airfare is reimbursable if booked at least 14 calendar days before departure. Business-class airfare requires advance written approval. Hotel accommodation is reimbursable up to $160 per night, excluding tax. Meal expenses are reimbursable up to $45 per calendar day; alcoholic beverages are excluded. Taxi fares are reimbursable when a flight arrives or departs after 10 P.M., or when public transportation is unavailable. A receipt is required for any individual expense exceeding $25.

### Elena’s Conference Expense Summary

Conference travel: November 18–21. Departure flight: November 18; economy ticket booked November 1. Hotel: three nights, November 18–21, at $175 per night before tax. Airport taxi: November 18, after an 11 P.M. arrival, $38; receipt retained. Meals: November 19, $32; November 20, $49. Both meals contain no alcohol, and receipts are available.

### Finance Team Reply

Elena, your airfare meets the advance-booking requirement. The hotel can offer our corporate rate of $150 per night for November 18–21, provided you amend the reservation by November 10; there is no change fee. Because your flight arrives at 11 P.M., the airport taxi is eligible, but please attach its receipt. The $49 meal exceeds the daily cap, so only $45 can be reimbursed for that day. The $32 meal is fully eligible. Please send the revised hotel confirmation after updating the booking.

### 題目與解析

### Q1

Why does Elena’s airfare qualify for reimbursement?

(A) It was booked at least 14 days before departure.  
(B) She booked business class.  
(C) Her employer waived all restrictions.  
(D) The flight is domestic.  

答案：**A**

November 1 to November 18 is 17 days, meeting the 14-day rule.

### Q2

By how much does the original nightly hotel rate exceed the cap?

(A) $10  
(B) $15  
(C) $25  
(D) $35  

答案：**B**

$175−$160=$15 per night.

### Q3

How much will the revised three-night hotel stay cost before tax?

(A) $450  
(B) $480  
(C) $525  
(D) $560  

答案：**A**

3×$150=$450.

### Q4

Why is the airport taxi eligible for reimbursement?

(A) The hotel is far from the airport.  
(B) The flight arrived after 10 P.M.  
(C) The fare was below $25.  
(D) The traveler was accompanied by colleagues.  

答案：**B**

The policy allows taxi reimbursement for flights arriving or departing after 10 P.M.; the flight arrived at 11 P.M.

### Q5

How much of the $49 meal is reimbursable?

(A) $0  
(B) $32  
(C) $45  
(D) $49  

答案：**C**

The daily meal cap is $45.

### Q6

Why must Elena submit the taxi receipt?

(A) All travel expenses require receipts.  
(B) The fare exceeded $25.  
(C) The taxi was booked in advance.  
(D) The hotel requested it.  

答案：**B**

A receipt is required for an individual expense over $25; the taxi fare was $38.

### Q7

By what date should Elena change her hotel reservation to get the corporate rate?

(A) November 1  
(B) November 10  
(C) November 18  
(D) November 21  

答案：**B**

The Finance e-mail specifies November 10.

### Q8

Excluding airfare and taxes, what is the maximum reimbursable total for the revised hotel, taxi, and two meals?

(A) $527  
(B) $557  
(C) $565  
(D) $569  

答案：**C**

$450 hotel + $38 taxi + $32 meal + $45 meal = $565.

sections.title: 難度調整與下一課
sections.markdown:
- **11–12 題正確**：Day 32: 900+ 多文件限制＋間接回應加速，新增更高干擾選項
- **9–10 題正確**：Day 32: 保持難度，針對錯誤標籤增加 4 題補強
- **7–8 題正確**：Day 32: 降低每題跨文件條件數，保留進階推論
- **0–6 題正確**：Day 32: 優先修復主詞動詞一致、時序與條件排除

questions.prompt: Each of the invoices _____ checked before payment.
questions.explanation: Each of + plural noun takes a singular verb: is.

questions.prompt: A number of applicants _____ qualified for the position.
questions.explanation: A number of + plural noun takes a plural verb: are.

questions.prompt: The number of orders _____ increased since July.
questions.explanation: The number of + plural noun is singular: has increased.

questions.prompt: Neither the manager nor the assistants _____ available this afternoon.
questions.explanation: With neither...nor, agreement commonly follows the nearer subject: assistants → are.

questions.prompt: The list of approved suppliers _____ on the company portal.
questions.explanation: The subject is list (singular), not suppliers.

questions.prompt: The equipment _____ yesterday is being tested.
questions.explanation: Reduced passive relative clause: equipment [that was] delivered yesterday.

questions.prompt: The technician responded _____ to the urgent request.
questions.explanation: An adverb modifies responded.

questions.prompt: The _____ estimate includes installation costs.
questions.explanation: Revised is the adjective/participle modifying estimate.

questions.prompt: _____ the repair was delayed, it was completed before the deadline.
questions.explanation: Although is followed by a full clause; despite/in spite of take noun phrases.

questions.prompt: The system will restart once the update _____.
questions.explanation: Future time clauses normally use present simple: once the update finishes.

questions.prompt: The shipment was _____ damaged during transport.
questions.explanation: Slightly modifies damaged.

questions.prompt: The employee _____ the request must provide identification.
questions.explanation: Submitting actively describes the employee who submits the request.

questions.prompt: The service is available to customers _____ warranties remain valid.
questions.explanation: Whose is a possessive relative determiner for warranties.

questions.prompt: The company requested a _____ explanation of the charges.
questions.explanation: Detailed modifies the noun explanation.

questions.prompt: Neither of the proposals _____ within the approved budget.
questions.explanation: In formal TOEIC-style agreement, neither of is treated as singular here: is.
